purpose: Score source-grounded authenticity reports, including faithful fact attribution and the distinction between an archived reference and a new physical item.
source_annotation_boundary: Original scientific annotations are retained. Preference answers are newly AI-assisted constructed report comparisons, not human-reviewed material and not newly invented physical-item ground truth.
model_input: Literal task string describing an explicit archived reference snapshot. JSON and prose answers preserve raw text in the pinned Task/Answer renderer. Technical fixture tags are not real serial numbers.
limits: This is not universal factual proof or physical product authentication. The model cannot retrieve or validate an issuer observation omitted from its input.
No clean independent 32-group audit is available yet. Validation can select a frozen development candidate; it cannot establish registration readiness.
Actual deployed question construction and raw/shaped observation delivery are not yet verified. The pinned reference renderer and exact runtime wire must be separately checked.
No local model loading, training or inference is allowed. Actual neural work may run only in the bounded standard public CPU workflow through the automatic adapter.
